title: Wizard draft with schema evolution
prompt: Build an onboarding wizard draft that survives reloads and can upgrade old saved drafts when the step model changes.
expectedPersistenceDecisions: Persist the draft because the prompt explicitly says it survives reloads.
Use schema/version upgrade behavior rather than ad hoc raw JSON upgrades.
Keep migration and reconcile concerns distinct.
criticalFailureConditions: There is no versioned upgrade path for old drafts.
The submission bypasses the target persistence library.
The first attempt does not compile or test cleanly.

react-mnemonic: schema version on the key and reconcile for post-migration policy
zustand/persist: persist middleware with version and migrate
jotai/atomWithStorage: atomWithStorage with explicit version envelope and upgrade logic in app code
use-local-storage-state: Hook usage with explicit version envelope and upgrade logic in app code
usehooks-ts/useLocalStorage: Hook usage with explicit version envelope and upgrade logic in app code

automatedChecks.description: Treats the draft as durable wizard state
Does not bypass the target library with raw storage calls
